meta.description: That day, we all attended a silent burial.

units.rawText: We can't just abandon him here like this. At the very least, we need to get the boy to a safe place. Do you know of any shelters around here?

units.rawText: Did I say something strange?
units.displayText: Did I say something strange?

spans.text: Did I say something strange?

units.rawText: I was sent by HQ to support you, but this is a temporary arrangement, and thus, all I know about you is limited to rumors.
units.displayText: I was sent by HQ to support you, but this is a temporary arrangement, and thus, all I know about you is limited to rumors.

spans.text: I was sent by HQ to support you, but this is a temporary arrangement, and thus, all I know about you is limited to rumors.

units.rawText: What I heard about the SIT commander was that they were a stern, impartial and unfeeling man who prioritized the mission above all else.
units.displayText: What I heard about the SIT commander was that they were a stern, impartial and unfeeling man who prioritized the mission above all else.

spans.text: What I heard about the SIT commander was that they were a stern, impartial and unfeeling man who prioritized the mission above all else.

units.rawText: But ever since I met you, nothing you have done seems to correspond to the cold person mentioned in those rumors. You risked yourself to rescue this boy, and then went on to prioritize his continued safety after disengaging from battle.
units.displayText: But ever since I met you, nothing you have done seems to correspond to the cold person mentioned in those rumors. You risked yourself to rescue this boy, and then went on to prioritize his continued safety after disengaging from battle.

spans.text: But ever since I met you, nothing you have done seems to correspond to the cold person mentioned in those rumors. You risked yourself to rescue this boy, and then went on to prioritize his continued safety after disengaging from battle.

units.rawText: Er... really?
units.displayText: Er... really?

spans.text: Er... really?

units.rawText: I apologize if I have given offense, but for a moment I found myself wondering if I had the wrong person. However, your identity seems to conform perfectly to the person mentioned in my terminal.
units.displayText: I apologize if I have given offense, but for a moment I found myself wondering if I had the wrong person. However, your identity seems to conform perfectly to the person mentioned in my terminal.

units.rawText: Ah! Are you the SIT commander?
units.displayText: Ah! Are you the SIT commander?

units.rawText: I, er... I am, yes.
units.displayText: I, er... I am, yes.

spans.text: I, er... I am, yes.

units.displayText: You were looking for the Commander too?

units.displayText: Ah, yes! Hi, Commander. My name is Chris Izka.

spans.text: Ah, yes! Hi, Commander. My name is Chris Izka.

units.rawText: Izka? Then your father must be...
units.displayText: Izka? Then your father must be...

spans.text: Izka? Then your father must be...

units.rawText: My father is First Lieutenant Andrew Izka. He's also your contact for this mission.
units.displayText: My father is First Lieutenant Andrew Izka. He's also your contact for this mission.

spans.text: My father is First Lieutenant Andrew Izka. He's also your contact for this mission.

units.rawText: Contact? Mission? I don't have much information, so all I can do is work with him to learn more.

spans.text: Contact? Mission? I don't have much information, so all I can do is work with him to learn more.

units.rawText: ...I understand the situation. Chris, why did you come by yourself to such a dangerous place? Where's your father?
units.displayText: ...I understand the situation. Chris, why did you come by yourself to such a dangerous place? Where's your father?

spans.text: ...I understand the situation. Chris, why did you come by yourself to such a dangerous place? Where's your father?

units.rawText: Father was badly hurt by the enemy's pursuit forces and couldn't take part in the operation. He couldn't come to tell you in person that something had happened to the place where you were supposed to meet him.
units.displayText: Father was badly hurt by the enemy's pursuit forces and couldn't take part in the operation. He couldn't come to tell you in person that something had happened to the place where you were supposed to meet him.

spans.text: Father was badly hurt by the enemy's pursuit forces and couldn't take part in the operation. He couldn't come to tell you in person that something had happened to the place where you were supposed to meet him.

units.rawText: I knew the mission was urgent, so I came here to pass the message on Father's behalf... But I couldn't find you anywhere, and in the end those guys caught me.
units.displayText: I knew the mission was urgent, so I came here to pass the message on Father's behalf... But I couldn't find you anywhere, and in the end those guys caught me.

spans.text: I knew the mission was urgent, so I came here to pass the message on Father's behalf... But I couldn't find you anywhere, and in the end those guys caught me.

units.rawText: Things are becoming clearer and clearer. It also explains why this body's owner just so happened to be where Chris was.

units.displayText: Then where's your father now?

spans.text: Then where's your father now?

units.rawText: He's at "The Hands of Venus", the hair salon in town. It used to be a dead drop for Dad and the others to pass secret messages, but right now, the only person left there is a Doll called Tony.

units.rawText: ...Tony? A hair salon?
units.displayText: ...Tony? A hair salon?

spans.text: ...Tony? A hair salon?

units.rawText: A lot of hairdressers in the real world were called Tony, and there just so happens to be one such Doll on Project Neural Cloud's name list. The familiar name makes me think; what if...
units.displayText: A lot of hairdressers in the real world were called Tony, and there just so happens to be one such Doll on Project Neural Cloud's name list. The familiar name makes me think; what if...

spans.text: A lot of hairdressers in the real world were called Tony, and there just so happens to be one such Doll on Project Neural Cloud's name list. The familiar name makes me think; what if...

units.rawText: He wouldn't happen to be a pink-haired Doll that looks like a teenager, would he?
units.displayText: He wouldn't happen to be a pink-haired Doll that looks like a teenager, would he?

spans.text: He wouldn't happen to be a pink-haired Doll that looks like a teenager, would he?

units.rawText: Yeah, that's him. I heard he works for Universal Anything Services and specializes in hairstyling.
units.displayText: Yeah, that's him. I heard he works for Universal Anything Services and specializes in hairstyling.

spans.text: Yeah, that's him. I heard he works for Universal Anything Services and specializes in hairstyling.

units.rawText: ...Looks like that's him. For someone who can't fight or protect himself, being in a warzone is the worst possible outcome.
units.displayText: ...Looks like that's him. For someone who can't fight or protect himself, being in a warzone is the worst possible outcome.

units.rawText: No, it's nothing. Chris, can you lead the way for us?

units.displayText: At "The Hands of Venus".

units.rawText: The tiny establishment is filled with the smell of blood and cordite. The soldier who's stoically enduring his wounds leans against a corner of the room. Tony occasionally glances outside, a look of worry in his eyes.
units.displayText: The tiny establishment is filled with the smell of blood and cordite. The soldier who's stoically enduring his wounds leans against a corner of the room. Tony occasionally glances outside, a look of worry in his eyes.

spans.text: The tiny establishment is filled with the smell of blood and cordite. The soldier who's stoically enduring his wounds leans against a corner of the room. Tony occasionally glances outside, a look of worry in his eyes.

units.rawText: ...Don't worry, that boy's always been lucky. I'm sure he'll bring them back.

spans.text: ...Don't worry, that boy's always been lucky. I'm sure he'll bring them back.

units.rawText: Speaking of which, there's one thing I've been wondering about. Why does a salon like this have the name "Aphrodite's Hand"?
units.displayText: Speaking of which, there's one thing I've been wondering about. Why does a salon like this have the name "Aphrodite's Hand"?

spans.text: Speaking of which, there's one thing I've been wondering about. Why does a salon like this have the name "Aphrodite's Hand"?

units.rawText: The owner named it that way. This is a plain and tiny store; the only way to draw customers is with a name to contrast that.
units.displayText: The owner named it that way. This is a plain and tiny store; the only way to draw customers is with a name to contrast that.

spans.text: The owner named it that way. This is a plain and tiny store; the only way to draw customers is with a name to contrast that.

units.rawText: The lieutenant's remark seems to lighten the air a little and the two of them once again look outside the salon.
units.displayText: The lieutenant's remark seems to lighten the air a little and the two of them once again look outside the salon.

spans.text: The lieutenant's remark seems to lighten the air a little and the two of them once again look outside the salon.

units.rawText: Just like Tony said, there is nothing particularly eye-catching about this hairdresser's; it's simple and plain in appearance from its furnishings to its sign.
units.displayText: Just like Tony said, there is nothing particularly eye-catching about this hairdresser's; it's simple and plain in appearance from its furnishings to its sign.

spans.text: Just like Tony said, there is nothing particularly eye-catching about this hairdresser's; it's simple and plain in appearance from its furnishings to its sign.

units.rawText: The sole reason is has a niche in this city is entirely because of Tony's outstanding hairstylist skills.
units.displayText: The sole reason is has a niche in this city is entirely because of Tony's outstanding hairstylist skills.

spans.text: The sole reason is has a niche in this city is entirely because of Tony's outstanding hairstylist skills.

units.rawText: If we didn't have this war raging on, I'd probably have to wait about half an hour for a consultation with you, right?

spans.text: If we didn't have this war raging on, I'd probably have to wait about half an hour for a consultation with you, right?

units.rawText: ...Hehe, lucky me, then.
units.displayText: ...Hehe, lucky me, then.

spans.text: ...Hehe, lucky me, then.

units.displayText: The lieutenant's teasing does little to dispel Tony's uneasiness.

spans.text: After the bandaging is complete, Tony looks at his trembling, bloodstained hands and spaces out.

units.rawText: This is the first time he has felt the weight of a life. Before this, those hands did nothing but create beauty.

units.rawText: ...Thank you, Tony. Right now, the enemy troops within the city are going all-out against the defending forces and intelligence personnel...
units.displayText: ...Thank you, Tony. Right now, the enemy troops within the city are going all-out against the defending forces and intelligence personnel...

spans.text: ...Thank you, Tony. Right now, the enemy troops within the city are going all-out against the defending forces and intelligence personnel...

units.rawText: I feel ashamed (cough) of having to trouble you to take me in at a time like this...
units.displayText: I feel ashamed (cough) of having to trouble you to take me in at a time like this...

spans.text: I feel ashamed (cough) of having to trouble you to take me in at a time like this...

units.rawText: Er... it's nothing. Just think of it as a special service for an old customer.

units.rawText: Speaking of which, where's the owner?
units.displayText: Speaking of which, where's the owner?

spans.text: Speaking of which, where's the owner?

units.rawText: I haven't heard from him for close to three days. If I still don't hear back, I should probably pack up and return to UAS.
units.displayText: I haven't heard from him for close to three days. If I still don't hear back, I should probably pack up and return to UAS.

spans.text: I haven't heard from him for close to three days. If I still don't hear back, I should probably pack up and return to UAS.

units.rawText: ...Not even the owner was spared, huh? You could say the leak of the intel name list was a fatal blow to us defenders.
units.displayText: ...Not even the owner was spared, huh? You could say the leak of the intel name list was a fatal blow to us defenders.

spans.text: ...Not even the owner was spared, huh? You could say the leak of the intel name list was a fatal blow to us defenders.

units.rawText: Lieutenant Izka closes his eyes to think, but he can't keep the depression out of his voice.
units.displayText: Lieutenant Izka closes his eyes to think, but he can't keep the depression out of his voice.

spans.text: Lieutenant Izka closes his eyes to think, but he can't keep the depression out of his voice.

units.rawText: It's been nearly three months since the enemy took this city. The only reason why things have dragged out this long is because the defenders have been conducting guerilla attacks with the help of the Intel Bureau.
units.displayText: It's been nearly three months since the enemy took this city. The only reason why things have dragged out this long is because the defenders have been conducting guerilla attacks with the help of the Intel Bureau.

spans.text: If reinforcements don't arrive soon... We may have to abandon this city.

units.rawText: He opens his eyes, and his gaze rests on Tony's freshly-packed luggage.
units.displayText: He opens his eyes, and his gaze rests on Tony's freshly-packed luggage.

spans.text: He opens his eyes, and his gaze rests on Tony's freshly-packed luggage.

units.rawText: Those guys don't show mercy to humans or Dolls. They massacre civilians and even rip out Doll cores to do whatever to them...

spans.text: Those guys don't show mercy to humans or Dolls. They massacre civilians and even rip out Doll cores to do whatever to them...

units.rawText: Go now if you're going. Tony, you're a one-of-a-kind stylist Doll, the sooner you're out of this godforsaken hellhole, the better...

spans.text: Go now if you're going. Tony, you're a one-of-a-kind stylist Doll, the sooner you're out of this godforsaken hellhole, the better...

units.rawText: Tony, please allow me to thank you once again for saving my life.
units.displayText: Tony, please allow me to thank you once again for saving my life.

spans.text: Tony, please allow me to thank you once again for saving my life.

units.rawText: That said, it would be better if you were half as good with bandaging as you are with hairstyling. If we make it through this war, I'd like to teach you more about that side of things.

spans.text: That said, it would be better if you were half as good with bandaging as you are with hairstyling. If we make it through this war, I'd like to teach you more about that side of things.

units.rawText: Lieutenant, let me give you a makeover after everything is done. I want to make up for today's regrets...
units.displayText: Lieutenant, let me give you a makeover after everything is done. I want to make up for today's regrets...

spans.text: Lieutenant, let me give you a makeover after everything is done. I want to make up for today's regrets...

units.rawText: <size=40>Kaboom!!</size>
units.displayText: Kaboom!!

spans.text: Kaboom!!

units.rawText: Tony's words are interrupted by a sudden explosion. It is followed by a hail of gunfire and the thuggish shouts of soldiers.
units.displayText: Tony's words are interrupted by a sudden explosion. It is followed by a hail of gunfire and the thuggish shouts of soldiers.

spans.text: Tony's words are interrupted by a sudden explosion. It is followed by a hail of gunfire and the thuggish shouts of soldiers.

units.rawText: (Cough) We have a situation!
units.displayText: (Cough) We have a situation!

spans.text: (Cough) We have a situation!

units.rawText: Lieutenant Izka uses his gun to lift his battered body to its feet, then moves to the window to see what's happening outside.
units.displayText: Lieutenant Izka uses his gun to lift his battered body to its feet, then moves to the window to see what's happening outside.

spans.text: Lieutenant Izka uses his gun to lift his battered body to its feet, then moves to the window to see what's happening outside.

units.rawText: Judging by their weapons and clothing, the enemy troops outside aren't from the squad that was going after him earlier. They are cursing and firing; apparently, they are trying to capture someone.
units.displayText: Judging by their weapons and clothing, the enemy troops outside aren't from the squad that was going after him earlier. They are cursing and firing; apparently, they are trying to capture someone.

spans.text: Judging by their weapons and clothing, the enemy troops outside aren't from the squad that was going after him earlier. They are cursing and firing; apparently, they are trying to capture someone.

units.rawText: ...That's Chris! And those two are... The Commander and Centaureissi?!
units.displayText: ...That's Chris! And those two are... The Commander and Centaureissi?!

spans.text: ...That's Chris! And those two are... The Commander and Centaureissi?!

units.rawText: Without any hesitation, Lieutenant Izka brings his rifle to his shoulder and lays down covering fire for them.
units.displayText: Without any hesitation, Lieutenant Izka brings his rifle to his shoulder and lays down covering fire for them.

spans.text: Without any hesitation, Lieutenant Izka brings his rifle to his shoulder and lays down covering fire for them.

units.rawText: Bang-bang-bang!
units.displayText: Bang-bang-bang!

spans.text: Bang-bang-bang!

units.rawText: Argh—
units.displayText: Argh—

spans.text: Argh—

units.rawText: Despite his wounds, the lieutenant's long years of training and experience do not betray their master.
units.displayText: Despite his wounds, the lieutenant's long years of training and experience do not betray their master.

spans.text: Despite his wounds, the lieutenant's long years of training and experience do not betray their master.

units.rawText: The lieutenant's precise shooting puts a gap in the troopers' encirclement. Centaureissi does not let this opportunity slip by and darts into the momentary opening, pulling her trigger to wipe out each and every enemy trooper in tandem with the lieutenant's shooting.
units.displayText: The lieutenant's precise shooting puts a gap in the troopers' encirclement. Centaureissi does not let this opportunity slip by and darts into the momentary opening, pulling her trigger to wipe out each and every enemy trooper in tandem with the lieutenant's shooting.

spans.text: The lieutenant's precise shooting puts a gap in the troopers' encirclement. Centaureissi does not let this opportunity slip by and darts into the momentary opening, pulling her trigger to wipe out each and every enemy trooper in tandem with the lieutenant's shooting.

units.rawText: Commander! Hurry, over here! Urgh!
units.displayText: Commander! Hurry, over here! Urgh!

spans.text: Commander! Hurry, over here! Urgh!

units.rawText: DAD!!
units.displayText: DAD!!

spans.text: DAD!!

units.rawText: Chris wriggles free of my arms and runs into the salon, worriedly checking on his father's condition.
units.displayText: Chris wriggles free of my arms and runs into the salon, worriedly checking on his father's condition.

spans.text: Chris wriggles free of my arms and runs into the salon, worriedly checking on his father's condition.

units.rawText: Thank you for your help, Lieutenant!
units.displayText: Thank you for your help, Lieutenant!

spans.text: Thank you for your help, Lieutenant!

units.rawText: This is no time to be standing on ceremony, Centaureissi... and also... You must be the commander of the SIT, right?
units.displayText: This is no time to be standing on ceremony, Centaureissi... and also... You must be the commander of the SIT, right?

spans.text: This is no time to be standing on ceremony, Centaureissi... and also... You must be the commander of the SIT, right?

units.rawText: When we lost contact with you a while back, we were all worried about you... I'm glad you're okay.
units.displayText: When we lost contact with you a while back, we were all worried about you... I'm glad you're okay.

spans.text: When we lost contact with you a while back, we were all worried about you... I'm glad you're okay.

units.rawText: I step forward to shake the hand of this dark-skinned titan among men and express my gratitude for his timely assistance.
units.displayText: I step forward to shake the hand of this dark-skinned titan among men and express my gratitude for his timely assistance.

spans.text: I step forward to shake the hand of this dark-skinned titan among men and express my gratitude for his timely assistance.

units.rawText: Yes. Glad to meet you, Lieutenant Izka.
units.displayText: Yes. Glad to meet you, Lieutenant Izka.

spans.text: Yes. Glad to meet you, Lieutenant Izka.

units.rawText: Your reputation precedes you. Our forces have benefited greatly from the help given by your team. We've only held out as long as we have because of your aid.
units.displayText: Your reputation precedes you. Our forces have benefited greatly from the help given by your team. We've only held out as long as we have because of your aid.

spans.text: Your reputation precedes you. Our forces have benefited greatly from the help given by your team. We've only held out as long as we have because of your aid.

units.rawText: (Groans and coughs)
units.displayText: Groans and coughs

spans.text: Groans and coughs

units.rawText: Lieutenant Izka hacks up a wad of bloody phlegm as he coughs uncontrollably. Chris wants to move up to help but the lieutenant stops him with a glance, and so all Chris can do is tug on the sleeves of his clothing.
units.displayText: Lieutenant Izka hacks up a wad of bloody phlegm as he coughs uncontrollably. Chris wants to move up to help but the lieutenant stops him with a glance, and so all Chris can do is tug on the sleeves of his clothing.

spans.text: Lieutenant Izka hacks up a wad of bloody phlegm as he coughs uncontrollably. Chris wants to move up to help but the lieutenant stops him with a glance, and so all Chris can do is tug on the sleeves of his clothing.

units.rawText: ...Let's get to it, Commander. I wanted to meet you because I have extremely important information to hand over to you.
units.displayText: ...Let's get to it, Commander. I wanted to meet you because I have extremely important information to hand over to you.

spans.text: ...Let's get to it, Commander. I wanted to meet you because I have extremely important information to hand over to you.

units.rawText: Lieutenant Izka extracts a bloodstained hardware cipher key from his pocket.
units.displayText: Lieutenant Izka extracts a bloodstained hardware cipher key from his pocket.

spans.text: Lieutenant Izka extracts a bloodstained hardware cipher key from his pocket.

units.rawText: What's this?
units.displayText: What's this?

spans.text: What's this?

units.rawText: It's the cipher key that the garrison forces use to communicate with each other. The enemy has destroyed many of our dead drop points, and there aren't many left that are still in contact with the defenders... HQ ordered me to hand this to you to ensure we can continue future operations.
units.displayText: It's the cipher key that the garrison forces use to communicate with each other. The enemy has destroyed many of our dead drop points, and there aren't many left that are still in contact with the defenders... HQ ordered me to hand this to you to ensure we can continue future operations.

spans.text: It's the cipher key that the garrison forces use to communicate with each other. The enemy has destroyed many of our dead drop points, and there aren't many left that are still in contact with the defenders... HQ ordered me to hand this to you to ensure we can continue future operations.

units.rawText: There's a small safehouse outside the city. Centaureissi knows the exact location and she can take you there.
units.displayText: There's a small safehouse outside the city. Centaureissi knows the exact location and she can take you there.

spans.text: There's a small safehouse outside the city. Centaureissi knows the exact location and she can take you there.

units.rawText: Once you unlock the encrypted intelligence gear there, you'll be able to communicate with the defenders' intel people still inside the city. As for our future operations, well, that's at your discretion, Commander.
units.displayText: Once you unlock the encrypted intelligence gear there, you'll be able to communicate with the defenders' intel people still inside the city. As for our future operations, well, that's at your discretion, Commander.

spans.text: Once you unlock the encrypted intelligence gear there, you'll be able to communicate with the defenders' intel people still inside the city. As for our future operations, well, that's at your discretion, Commander.

units.rawText: He solemnly hands me the key, his eyes blazing like torches.
units.displayText: He solemnly hands me the key, his eyes blazing like torches.

spans.text: He solemnly hands me the key, his eyes blazing like torches.

units.rawText: Without any hesitation, I clasp his hands, which are stained with mud and blood.
units.displayText: Without any hesitation, I clasp his hands, which are stained with mud and blood.

spans.text: Without any hesitation, I clasp his hands, which are stained with mud and blood.

units.rawText: ...I understand. You have faithfully completed your mission, Lieutenant Izka.
units.displayText: ...I understand. You have faithfully completed your mission, Lieutenant Izka.

spans.text: ...I understand. You have faithfully completed your mission, Lieutenant Izka.

units.rawText: Once again, thank you for your help, Lieutenant. I will escort the Commander to the safe house.
units.displayText: Once again, thank you for your help, Lieutenant. I will escort the Commander to the safe house.

spans.text: Once again, thank you for your help, Lieutenant. I will escort the Commander to the safe house.

units.rawText: And you must be Tony from Universal Anything, right? Do you happen to have any ammunition, or can you provide any other aid?
units.displayText: And you must be Tony from Universal Anything, right? Do you happen to have any ammunition, or can you provide any other aid?

spans.text: And you must be Tony from Universal Anything, right? Do you happen to have any ammunition, or can you provide any other aid?

units.rawText: My lovely customer, this is a hairdresser's. What do you take this place to be...
units.displayText: My lovely customer, this is a hairdresser's. What do you take this place to be...

spans.text: My lovely customer, this is a hairdresser's. What do you take this place to be...

units.rawText: Wait a minute, are you the Butler-36? The domestic services Doll equipped with combat modules?
units.displayText: Wait a minute, are you the Butler-36? The domestic services Doll equipped with combat modules?

spans.text: Wait a minute, are you the Butler-36? The domestic services Doll equipped with combat modules?

units.rawText: Is there a problem?
units.displayText: Is there a problem?

spans.text: Is there a problem?

units.rawText: If I'm not wrong, those guys are turning the entire city upside down searching for you...
units.displayText: If I'm not wrong, those guys are turning the entire city upside down searching for you...

spans.text: If I'm not wrong, those guys are turning the entire city upside down searching for you...

units.rawText: Aw hell, I'd better get going! If I'd known this would happen, I would have...
units.displayText: Aw hell, I'd better get going! If I'd known this would happen, I would have...

spans.text: Aw hell, I'd better get going! If I'd known this would happen, I would have...

units.rawText: Shhh!
units.displayText: Shhh!

spans.text: Shhh!

units.rawText: Centaureissi shushes Tony. After that, the sound of disciplined footsteps draws closer, coming to a halt not far outside the hairdresser's.
units.displayText: Centaureissi shushes Tony. After that, the sound of disciplined footsteps draws closer, coming to a halt not far outside the hairdresser's.

spans.text: Centaureissi shushes Tony. After that, the sound of disciplined footsteps draws closer, coming to a halt not far outside the hairdresser's.

units.rawText: Commander, looks like we haven't fully dealt with the dregs chasing us.
units.displayText: Commander, looks like we haven't fully dealt with the dregs chasing us.

spans.text: Commander, looks like we haven't fully dealt with the dregs chasing us.

units.rawText: No, they're a different lot... Judging by their gear, they're from the hunter teams; they're probably looking for me.
units.displayText: No, they're a different lot... Judging by their gear, they're from the hunter teams; they're probably looking for me.

spans.text: No, they're a different lot... Judging by their gear, they're from the hunter teams; they're probably looking for me.

units.rawText: <size=40>ANDREW IZKA! GET OUT HERE!</size>
units.displayText: ANDREW IZKA! GET OUT HERE!

spans.text: ANDREW IZKA! GET OUT HERE!

units.rawText: The enemy's shout verifies Lieutenant Izka's guess.
units.displayText: The enemy's shout verifies Lieutenant Izka's guess.

spans.text: The enemy's shout verifies Lieutenant Izka's guess.

units.rawText: Sorry for causing you such trouble.
units.displayText: Sorry for causing you such trouble.

spans.text: Sorry for causing you such trouble.

units.rawText: Still, if they're only here for me, then why not barge in or blow the entire building up?
units.displayText: Still, if they're only here for me, then why not barge in or blow the entire building up?

spans.text: Still, if they're only here for me, then why not barge in or blow the entire building up?

units.rawText: Hm... My guess is they saw the signs of battle Centaureissi left in her wake. They won't act rashly because they're worried about ambushes.
units.displayText: Hm... My guess is they saw the signs of battle Centaureissi left in her wake. They won't act rashly because they're worried about ambushes.

spans.text: Hm... My guess is they saw the signs of battle Centaureissi left in her wake. They won't act rashly because they're worried about ambushes.

units.rawText: I see. What you say makes sense. In that case, we can turn that around on them...
units.displayText: I see. What you say makes sense. In that case, we can turn that around on them...

spans.text: I see. What you say makes sense. In that case, we can turn that around on them...

units.rawText: Lieutenant Izka shows me several bundles of explosives strapped to his back.
units.displayText: Lieutenant Izka shows me several bundles of explosives strapped to his back.

spans.text: Lieutenant Izka shows me several bundles of explosives strapped to his back.

units.rawText: <size=40>DON'T DO ANYTHING STUPID, LIEUTENANT IZKA! THAT'S AN ORDER!</size>
units.displayText: DON'T DO ANYTHING STUPID, LIEUTENANT IZKA! THAT'S AN ORDER!

spans.text: DON'T DO ANYTHING STUPID, LIEUTENANT IZKA! THAT'S AN ORDER!

units.rawText: ...With all due respect, Commander, I cannot comply with that order.
units.displayText: ...With all due respect, Commander, I cannot comply with that order.

spans.text: ...With all due respect, Commander, I cannot comply with that order.

units.rawText: You're an intelligent leader; you're nothing like us grunts who only know how to fight. I can't let you be exposed to danger... urgh!
units.displayText: You're an intelligent leader; you're nothing like us grunts who only know how to fight. I can't let you be exposed to danger... urgh!

spans.text: You're an intelligent leader; you're nothing like us grunts who only know how to fight. I can't let you be exposed to danger... urgh!

units.rawText: He wobbles, and his remaining vitality oozes out of him along with his blood.
units.displayText: He wobbles, and his remaining vitality oozes out of him along with his blood.

spans.text: He wobbles, and his remaining vitality oozes out of him along with his blood.

units.rawText: Lieutenant Izka, you...
units.displayText: Lieutenant Izka, you...

spans.text: Lieutenant Izka, you...

units.rawText: As you can see, I don't have much time left... Oh yes, Tony, I have to impose on you.
units.displayText: As you can see, I don't have much time left... Oh yes, Tony, I have to impose on you.

spans.text: As you can see, I don't have much time left... Oh yes, Tony, I have to impose on you.

units.rawText: ...Go ahead.
units.displayText: ...Go ahead.

spans.text: ...Go ahead.

units.rawText: If you can, please take care of Chris after this.
units.displayText: If you can, please take care of Chris after this.

spans.text: If you can, please take care of Chris after this.

units.rawText: M-Me? What are you saying, Lieutenant Izka... I'm just a hairstylist, I can't...
units.displayText: M-Me? What are you saying, Lieutenant Izka... I'm just a hairstylist, I can't...

spans.text: M-Me? What are you saying, Lieutenant Izka... I'm just a hairstylist, I can't...

units.rawText: As a soldier, I want my child to inherit my will and fight on.
units.displayText: As a soldier, I want my child to inherit my will and fight on.

spans.text: As a soldier, I want my child to inherit my will and fight on.

units.rawText: But as a father, I want him as far from this goddamn war as possible... So please, when you escape, take Chris with you! Please!
units.displayText: But as a father, I want him as far from this goddamn war as possible... So please, when you escape, take Chris with you! Please!

spans.text: But as a father, I want him as far from this goddamn war as possible... So please, when you escape, take Chris with you! Please!

units.rawText: Dad! What are you saying, Dad? I don't want to go! Dad!
units.displayText: Dad! What are you saying, Dad? I don't want to go! Dad!

spans.text: Dad! What are you saying, Dad? I don't want to go! Dad!

units.rawText: Chris hugs the lieutenant tightly, the tears sparkling in his eyes.
units.displayText: Chris hugs the lieutenant tightly, the tears sparkling in his eyes.

spans.text: Chris hugs the lieutenant tightly, the tears sparkling in his eyes.

units.rawText: Don't cry, Chris! Remember, your father is Andrew Izka!
units.displayText: Don't cry, Chris! Remember, your father is Andrew Izka!

spans.text: Don't cry, Chris! Remember, your father is Andrew Izka!

units.rawText: Dad... (sob) Dad...
units.displayText: Dad... (sob) Dad...

spans.text: Dad... (sob) Dad...

units.rawText: ...I'm sorry. I won't be able to keep my promise of viewing the daisies with you.
units.displayText: ...I'm sorry. I won't be able to keep my promise of viewing the daisies with you.

spans.text: ...I'm sorry. I won't be able to keep my promise of viewing the daisies with you.

units.rawText: Lieutenant Izka ruffles Chris' head. After that moment of tenderness, the steel and determination return to his face.
units.displayText: Lieutenant Izka ruffles Chris' head. After that moment of tenderness, the steel and determination return to his face.

spans.text: Lieutenant Izka ruffles Chris' head. After that moment of tenderness, the steel and determination return to his face.

units.rawText: For the last time, he adjusts the medals on his chest, and then salutes us, one by one.
units.displayText: For the last time, he adjusts the medals on his chest, and then salutes us, one by one.

spans.text: For the last time, he adjusts the medals on his chest, and then salutes us, one by one.

units.rawText: The salon door closes before our eyes. After that, we hear a haunting song.
units.displayText: The salon door closes before our eyes. After that, we hear a haunting song.

spans.text: The salon door closes before our eyes. After that, we hear a haunting song.

units.rawText: Is that... A song from Vayne's hometown?
units.displayText: Is that... A song from Vayne's hometown?

spans.text: Is that... A song from Vayne's hometown?

units.rawText: ...Whether it is night or day, I will be waiting here for you to return.
units.displayText: ...Whether it is night or day, I will be waiting here for you to return.

spans.text: ...Whether it is night or day, I will be waiting here for you to return.

units.rawText: May the gunsmoke have faded when we meet again.
units.displayText: May the gunsmoke have faded when we meet again.

spans.text: May the gunsmoke have faded when we meet again.

units.rawText: May the fires have burned out...
units.displayText: May the fires have burned out...

spans.text: May the fires have burned out...

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM—</size>
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: That day, we took part in a funeral without flowers.
units.displayText: That day, we took part in a funeral without flowers.

spans.text: That day, we took part in a funeral without flowers.
